data.title: BlackRock dominated with 83% as US spot Bitcoin ETFs raked in $606M, the largest sum since May. Altcoin funds also joined the party.

data.title: CPL Announces Next Phase of Leadership as Firm Continues Growth and Strategic Momentum
data.description: As of August 1, Todd Liebert shifted to a Senior Advisor position while Chris Colby takes over leadership at CPL. The company, based in Rochester, New York, made this move on August 21, 2026. A search is underway for the next chief executive.

data.title: 3E Strengthens Trusted AI with ISO/IEC 42001 Certification
data.description: In Carlsbad, California, 3E has successfully obtained ISO/IEC 42001:2023 certification. This certification serves as recognition of the company's effective governance of AI within its product compliance solutions.

data.title: Leon Stok of IBM Reelected Silicon Integration Initiative Board Chair
data.description: In Round Rock, Texas, Leon Stok, the vice president of Electronic Design Automation at IBM, has been reelected as the board chair of the Silicon Integration Initiative for the term spanning 2026-2027. Dr. Stok has been a member of the Si2 Board since 2007 and has held various leadership positions, including previous terms as Board Chair. Leading a team at IBM that provides top-notch design and verification flows and tools for developing advanced computing systems like IBM Z, Dr. Stok continues his longstanding commitment to Si2.

data.title: HPE Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Storage Platforms
data.description: HPE, listed as HPE on NYSE, has been identified as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant and acknowledged in Critical Capabilities for Enterprise Storage Platforms. According to Jim O'Dorisio, the SVP & GM for storage at HPE, this acknowledgment by Gartner validates the company's commitment to innovation and quality in enterprise data management. As businesses navigate the evolving landscape shaped by AI technology, HPE aims to provide comprehensive solutions beyond basic data storage facilities.

data.title: Game, Set, Pit! Dickey’s Barbecue Launches Mobile Games To Connect with Next Generation of Fans
data.description: In Dallas, the world's largest barbecue concept, Dickey's Barbecue Pit, revealed that close to 30% of online orders are made via their mobile app. To enhance customer engagement, they have introduced three new interactive mobile games solely for members of the Big Yellow Cup Rewards program. This move aims to incentivize users to earn loyalty points through active participation within the app. The games are now live and offer an exciting way for fans to accumulate rewards points while enjoying the app's features.
